# Plot Pre-Submission Checklist

Use this checklist before finalizing any figure for publication, presentation, or report.

## Message & Data
- [ ] I can state in one sentence what this chart communicates
- [ ] The chart type matches the data relationship (see chart-types reference)
- [ ] Data is correct and sourced; units are specified
- [ ] Outliers are explained or explicitly retained by design

## Labels & Text
- [ ] Title is concise, sentence case, describes the finding (not just "X vs Y")
- [ ] Both axes have labels with units: `Label (unit)`
- [ ] Tick values are readable (≤8 per axis, no overlap)
- [ ] Legend is present only when ≥2 series; labels are self-explanatory
- [ ] All annotations are legible at final export size

## Color & Accessibility
- [ ] Color palette is perceptually uniform or qualitative-appropriate
- [ ] Plot is distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] No red–green pairing as the only differentiator
- [ ] Text contrast ratio ≥4.5:1 against background

## Layout & Style
- [ ] Top and right spines are removed (or chart style is consistent with publication)
- [ ] No 3-D effects, gradients, or drop shadows
- [ ] Grid lines are subtle (light gray) or absent
- [ ] Figure margins prevent clipping of labels
- [ ] Aspect ratio is appropriate for the medium (4:3 / 16:9 / 1:1)

## Export
- [ ] Resolution ≥300 dpi for print; ≥150 dpi for screen
- [ ] Vector format (PDF/SVG) used when possible
- [ ] Fonts are embedded in PDF export
- [ ] File is named descriptively (not `figure1.png`)

## Reproducibility
- [ ] Plot is generated by a script (not a GUI click sequence)
- [ ] Random seeds are set for any stochastic elements
- [ ] Data source and version are documented in the script or a companion file
